formation.plist_drift_mechanism: promotion writes actor, runtime manifest, readiness acknowledgements and barrier; it does not install or bootstrap live plist files
formation.provider_residue_operation: runner persisted a succeeded attempt plus inbox response after coordinator had persisted writer pending; no later coordinator consumption moved the run to a terminal state

contract_findings.promotion_vs_live_service: separate boundaries; promotion COMMITTED does not imply installed service identity
contract_findings.formal_activation_seam: scripts/install_agy_gemini_coordinator_launchd.sh --install then --activate; aggregate activation replaces and bootstraps all seven services with rollback and live aggregate validation
contract_findings.candidate_creation: a current acceptance candidate must be a newly created scheduler/backlog run under current actor identity; resume of the 2026-08-26 active run is not current-fresh
contract_findings.old_run_terminalization: existing terminalize-pending rejects any provider outcome or production-attempt evidence; terminalize-dangling-active applies only when run_dir is missing; therefore neither existing seam can safely terminalize this exact residue
contract_findings.scheduler_behavior: new matrix sweep creates at most one run per cycle when active create count is below the floor, but lane selection always advances the oldest registered active run first

durable_invariants: promotion acceptance and installed-service acceptance are distinct; provider execution requires both identities to match the same current actor/manifest/generation tuple
a provider response belongs to one immutable job/request/attempt identity and may be resumed only as that historical attempt, never relabeled as a current call

current production acceptance requires a run created under the current acceptance window with no earlier succeeded provider outcome, plus candidate/reviewer/publish/public closure from the same correlation chain
old inbox/archive evidence must remain immutable; terminalization may add a receipt and terminal state but must not delete or quarantine historical evidence

minimal_frontier.repair: add one hash-bound plan-only/execute operator seam for active + writer-pending + succeeded-attempt + matching inbox/archive + no candidate/review; it may only terminalize the run and add an immutable receipt
operation_after_repair: while seven services remain stopped, terminalize the exact stale run through the new seam without deleting inbox/archive
run current seven-service preflight and private stage install
perform authorized aggregate activation/reload for the same current manifest tuple
allow the formal new-matrix scheduler to create one new backlog run, then select that exact current run
minimal_frontier.why_not_less: activation alone leaves the oldest stale run selected; creating a second run alone still leaves the oldest run authoritative; resume consumes the historical provider response
minimal_frontier.why_not_more: no registry, FSM, new scheduler, queue rewrite, bulk cleanup or publisher change is required
do_not_absorb: deletion or quarantine of old inbox/archive
